Hi Daniel / Priya — glad to meet virtually. Quick note from the exec sponsor perspective to set expectations before tomorrow's kickoff: 

1) Outcomes we propose for a Q4 proof-of-value (PoV):
   - Demonstrable >5% improvement in throughput for production-like prompts vs your current baseline
   - Stable median latency under 350ms at target concurrency (as captured in the MAP)
   - A validated cost model with recommendations for batching/quantization that shows a path to 30% unit cost reduction at scale

2) Escalation & ownership:
   - Customer issues that block acceptance: escalate to me (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai). I will coordinate with our SRE and Product leads.
   - Operational incidents during evaluation: Vanessa will be the primary technical contact.

3) Acceptance gating: the MAP sheet contains columns for "Test", "Owner", "Acceptance Criteria", and "Completion Date". We should be explicit about who signs off for each gate (evaluation lead vs. VP).

Link to a short escalation playbook I referenced (internal view): https://drive.redwood.com/Prism/ExecPlaybook (I'll share a customer-facing copy in the kickoff).

Looking forward to tomorrow.

—Rishi
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
